raw_segments.text: Cassius! Come, Antony, and young Octavius, come, revenge yourselves alone on Cassius,
for Cassius is a weary of the world. Hated by one he loves, braved by his brother, checked
like a bondman, all his faults observed, set in a notebook, learned and conned by rote
to cast into my teeth. Oh, I could weep my spirit from mine eyes. There is my dagger
and hear my naked breast. Within, a heart dearer than plutus mine, richer than gold.
If that thou beest he a Roman, take it forth. I that denied thee gold, will give my heart.
Strike as thou didst at Caesar. For I know, when thou didst hate him worst, thou lov'dst him better
